claim: Known inclusion-probability Horvitz-Thompson correction improves population risk estimation over an unweighted uncertainty-focused sample.
Poststratification to actual population strata proportions reduces MSE versus unweighted allocation-biased survey means.
Augmented design-unbiased risk estimation outperforms unweighted mild PPS sample means.
Horvitz-Thompson estimator improves over ratio normalization in strongly targeted acquisition.
Purposeful oversampling of high predicted error strata with design weights improves efficiency versus proportional risk stratification.
